prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1456; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The injury does not fit the crash: the impact was very light, yet the claimed injury is severe.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck from behind while turning left. Reported complaints involved the cervical and lumbar regions. Over the course of 18 visits, care consisted of manual therapy, guided stretching, and a home exercise program, and it progressed in a typical pattern, with frequency reduced as symptoms improved. Physical examination showed reduced range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness in both areas, consistent with a soft tissue strain, while several neurological and orthopedic screening tests were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior symptoms or treatment involving these body regions. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, without duplicate entries. The mechanism of the impact was low in energy, and the severity of the reported symptoms is greater than what would typically be expected from a collision of that force. Ongoing care is discharged as of the most recent visit, with the patient advised to continue self-directed exercise as needed.
